description: Source code for the ACameraMetadata class implementation, handling camera metadata processing in Android's camera framework, including filtering capabilities, stream configurations, and physical camera IDs.

classes.name: ACameraMetadata
classes.description: Class managing camera metadata, including filtering and querying capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes metadata filtering based on type.

methods.name: isNdkSupportedCapability
methods.description: Checks if a capability is supported by NDK.

methods.name: derivePhysicalCameraIds
methods.description: Derives physical camera IDs for logical multi-camera devices.

methods.name: filterDurations
methods.description: Filters and translates duration-related metadata entries.

methods.name: filterStreamConfigurations
methods.description: Filters and translates stream configuration metadata entries.

methods.name: isVendorTag
methods.description: Determines if a tag is vendor-specific.

methods.name: getConstEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a constant metadata entry by tag.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates metadata entries with new data.

methods.name: isLogicalMultiCamera
methods.description: Checks if the camera is a logical multi-camera and retrieves physical IDs.

methods.name: isCaptureRequestTag
methods.description: Determines if a tag is valid for capture requests.
